senses.gloss: m. (= b. h. יְהָב; preced.) [that which is put on,] bundle, load on the back.
units: R. Hash. 26ᵇ; Meg. 18ᵃ (as an analogy to יהב, Ps. LV, 23) the Arab said, שקול יְהָבִיךְ וכ׳ take off thy bundle and put it on my camel; Gen. R. s. 79, end תלי הדין י׳ עלי help me to put my load on; שמעון מיניה י׳ משדי from this they learned that y’haba means load
